_comment: A verbatim copy of the Public Suffix List, fetched with
asks to be pulled from). It is byte-identical to publicsuffix/list at the commit below plus the
two-line VERSION/COMMIT header publicsuffix.org adds. The digest is the sha256 of the file's bytes;
pyrxd.network.source_identity refuses to read a file whose bytes do not match it, and
tests/test_source_operator_groups.py enforces the pin. Licence: MPL-2.0 (the header of the file).
Do NOT hand-edit the vendored file: a byte changed is a digest that no longer matches. To refresh,
re-fetch, update commit/fetched/digest together, and re-run the operator-group tests.
